channel.description: The New York Times এর সর্বশেষ খবর

item.title: [The New York Times] For Trump and America, a Clear Election Verdict but a Murky Future
item.description: As Americans absorb a stunning new political reality, they face a gap between the time they effectively decided to be done with the president and the time he is actually done.

item.title: [The New York Times] For Stephen Miller, Election Defeat Is No Reason to Back Down on Immigration Crackdown
item.description: The president’s new chief of staff has already demonstrated his intention to forge ahead with an agenda that many voters rejected.

item.title: [The New York Times] Hakeem Jeffries, in Line to Become House Speaker, Promises Bold Agenda
item.description: The man in line to be the first Black speaker is a reserved moderate seen by activists on the left as too timid to take on President Trump. He says he’s “strongly positioned” to get things done.

item.title: [The New York Times] Republicans Point Fingers, but Trump Does Not Appear to Be Listening
item.description: After last week’s midterm losses, the Republican Party entered its most uncertain moment in years. Some Republicans called for moderation and cleaning house, but that will be difficult with President Trump still in the White House.

item.title: [The New York Times] Keisha Lance Bottoms on What Democrats Have to Do to Not Squander the Win
item.description: The governor-elect of Georgia is elated about her party’s victories in the South, but knows realignment is far from secure.

item.title: [The New York Times] How Mississippi Reached the Verge of Electing a Black Senator
item.description: The echoes of history surround Scott Colom’s final push toward victory, but assembling the coalition that propelled him took hard work after many Democratic misses.

item.title: [The New York Times] Top Astrophysicist Leaves U.S. After Trump Policies Affect Her Work
item.description: Kelly Holley-Bockelmann was one of the top astrophysicists in the country until President Trump’s policies affected every part of her work.

item.title: [The New York Times] How Trump Is Dismantling America’s Scientific Research Machine
item.description: The system that has driven life-altering discoveries and helped make the United States a superpower is now under intense strain.

item.title: [The New York Times] Who Is Gadi Eisenkot, Israel’s Opposition Leader?
item.description: Mr. Eisenkot, a career general and the leading rival of Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu of Israel, will now have up to six weeks to form a coalition.

item.title: [The New York Times] After ‘Babydoll’, Dominic Fike Embraces the Mess
item.description: In the wake of a viral hit, new sobriety and fatherhood, the rocker scrapped the album he had been working on to make a less-polished LP.
